correctness.rationale: For the two displayed distinct length-50 binary words u=0xy1 and v=0yx1, independent exact prefix-DP and independently enumerated nonadjacent index-tuples give the same multiplicity for all 62 binary patterns of lengths 1..5, with zero mismatches; common totals are 50, 1176, 17296, 178365, 1370754 by length. The required convention is index gaps >=2. The words are different, so this is an explicit collision and proves the finite upper bound G(5)<=50 without claiming minimality.

originality.rationale: Golm–Nahvi–Gabrys–Milenkovic gave G(2)=6, G(3)=13, G(4)=24 and their general bound gives G(5)<=122. Rigo–Stipulanti–Whiteland (2023) treat gapped-binomial equivalence/infinite-word complexities and do not supply this finite order-five witness in material inspected. A targeted published-findings semantic search for the same threshold did not find a covering result. Original 2022 full PDF unavailable on attempted arXiv download; originality is best-of-knowledge, not a claimed negative full-document inspection.
residual_risks: An unindexed shorter collision or published small-case computation may dominate the bound.
